sections.title: A shop *full of makers*
body: We are a compilation of more than fifteen artists, from painters to glassmakers, soap makers and jewelers, and everything in the shop is made by our artists' own hands.
We have temporarily downsized and renamed the shop the Little Red Fox Shop, but many of our amazing local artists are still here, along with a clothing line for women and girls.

sections.title: Come see what's new
sections.text: Find us at 109 Laurens Street NW.

before: The shop's web address, littleredfoxshop.com, no longer exists, and neither does its online store at shopinspiredinside.com
Customers looking for the artists or the new storefront find old listings instead
The words on this concept come from the Visit Aiken listing; photos of the work and the artists would come from the shop
after: A working page, today: phone, address and map in one obvious place
One-tap call and directions on a phone
HTTPS that renews itself, with nothing to patch or let lapse
A proper preview when the link is shared by text or on Facebook
Room for a page per artist, photos of new work and an online shop once the artists supply them
